parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The rule ID. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description:
The alerting name. Valid values:
- ALL: all Alarm Metric.

parameters.name: FieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the field to be whitelisted.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description:
The operator used for rule matching. Valid values:
- strEqual: string equals.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The business source. Valid values:
- agentless: agentless detection.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the target scope. Valid values:
- ALL: all assets
- SELECTION_KEY: assets selected by using the asset selection component.

parameters.name: TargetValue
parameters.description:
The target scope. Valid values:
- ALL: all assets
- Other values: the key of the asset scope selected by using the asset selection component.
